الطريقة

1. سخّني الفرن إلى 180 درجة مئوية، وادهني قالب الكيك بالقليل من الزبدة أو الزيت ورشيه بالدقيق.

* آيس كريم للتقديم 🍦

الطريقة:

1. ذوّبي الزبدة، واسكبيها وهي دافئة فوق السكر البني والسكر الأبيض.
2. اخفقي جيداً حتى يصبح الخليط ناعماً ولامعاً.
3. اتركي الخليط يبرد قليلاً لمدة دقيقة أو دقيقتين.
4. أضيفي البيضة والفانيلا واخلطي جيداً.
5. أضيفي الطحين والبيكنج صودا والملح وقلّبي حتى تتجانس المكونات.
6. أضيفي قطع الشوكولاتة وقلّبي.
7. شكّلي العجينة إلى كرات وضعيها على صينية الخَبز.
8. اخبزيها على حرارة 190°C لمدة 12–15 دقيقة، حتى تصبح الأطراف ذهبية والوسط ما زال طرياً قليلاً.
9. ضعي سكوب آيس كريم في طبق، وحطي فوقه الكوكيز وهي دافية 🍪🍦
10. وقدميها فوراً… وحاولي توقفي أكل

Ingredients:

* ½ cup melted butter (113g)
* ½ cup brown sugar (100g)
* ¼ cup granulated sugar (50g)
* 1 large egg
* 1 tsp vanilla (5g)
* 1¼ cups all-purpose flour (150g)
* ½ tsp baking soda (3g)
* ¼ tsp salt (1.5g)
* Chocolate chips, to taste 🍫
* Ice cream, for serving 🍦

Instructions:

1. Melt the butter and pour it while warm over the brown sugar and granulated sugar.
2. Whisk until smooth and glossy.
3. Let the mixture cool for 1–2 minutes.
4. Add the egg and vanilla and mix well.
5. Fold in the flour, baking soda, and salt until just combined.
6. Fold in the chocolate chips.
7. Shape the dough into balls and place them on a baking sheet.
8. Bake at 190°

🍋🍰 Cream Cheese 7UP Pound Cake! 💚✨

👇🏾RECIPE 👇🏾
📝 Ingredients:

 • 3 cups cake flour
 • 3 sticks unsalted butter, softened
 • 8 oz cream cheese, softened
 • 3 cups granulated sugar
 • 1½ tsp clear vanilla extract
 • 1 tsp lemon extract
 • 5 large eggs
 • ¾ cup 7UP soda

👩🏽‍🍳 Instructions:

 1. Preheat your oven to 325°F.
 2. Cream together the softened butter and cream cheese until smooth.
 3. Add the sugar and beat for 3–4 minutes until light and fluffy.
 4. Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
 5. Mix in the vanilla and lemon extracts.
 6. Alternately add the cake flour and 7UP, beginning and ending with the flour. Mix just until combined.
 7. Pour the batter into a greased and floured Bundt or pound cake pan.
 8. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
 9. Let cool, then slice and enjoy! 🤤🍰

Co-branding isn’t a trend. It’s a power move.�Local brands are teaming up to win market share, relevance, and attention faster than ever. When both names bring real value, co-branding becomes a shortcut to visibility, trial, and cultural buzz.

Here’s how brands in Egypt are doing it right 👇

1. Kraft Heinz  × Chipsy (PepsiCo Egypt) �A flavor-packed drop. Chipsy launched limited sandwich-inspired chips using Heinz’s iconic sauces. Ketchup, BBQ, and Burger all made the cut.

1. V7 × DARA’s Ice Cream�Summer in a cup. A zesty pink lemonade born from V7’s soda and DARA’s playful twist.

2. Dolato Gelateria  × Juhayna�Artisan gelato powered by rich Egyptian dairy. Dolato used Juhayna’s milk to bring creamy authenticity to every scoop.

3. Lychee Egypt x DARA’s Ice Cream�Texture meets taste. DARA’s honeycomb chunks folded into Lychee’s smooth vanilla yogurt.

4. Schweppes × Everyday Roastery Coffee �Fizz with flair. Schweppes created in-store specialty drinks with Everyday Roastery using its bold soda lineup.

5. Juhayna x Copa Acai �Clean fuel. Smoothies and Greek yogurt co-created to deliver both flavor and function.

But here’s the catch ⚠️�You can’t borrow credibility if you haven’t built it.

Store-bought cream soda is made from ingredients like high fructose corn syrup and artificial flavors, which are a no-no when it comes to overall health & hormonal wellness. 

So as always we’re enjoying all the tasty things but made the way nature intended with nourishing all-natural ingredients. ↓ 

• 1/2 cup maple syrup
• 1/2 cup water
• 2 tsp freshly squeezed lemon juice
• 1 tbsp vanilla extract
• unflavored seltzer to top off

Pour your maple syrup, water, vanilla extract, and lemon juice into a glass bowl or container. Stir to combine. This is your simple cream soda concentrate! 

When ready to drink, fill a glass with ice and pour about 1/4-1/2 way with the cream soda concentrate (depending on how sweet you like it) and top off with plain seltzer. Give the drink a swirl and enjoy!

*Recipe yields about 4 drinks.
